title: Firebloom
wikitext:
'''Firebloom''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (205).

==Source==
Firebloom can be found in hot regions, most frequently [[Tanaris]] and the [[Searing Gorge]], but also in the [[Blasted Lands]] and the [[Badlands]].

===Pickable Zones===
*[[Tanaris]]		41.6%
*[[Searing Gorge]]	24.3%
*[[Badlands]]		21.4%
*[[Blasted Lands]]	12.8%
